name: Jonathan Eleonidas Arroyo Yunda
bio: Nexus Verium was founded by Jonathan Eleonidas Arroyo Yunda, an environmental science student and systems thinker focused on the responsible integration of AI into environmental and human systems. With a background in environmental science, engineering concepts, and AI systems design, he guides applied research, prototyping, and real-world implementation across the River Veins initiative.

name: Jensy Jimenez
bio: Jensy Jimenez is the Lead Environmental AI Systems Engineer at Nexus Verium, where he builds intelligent systems that turn environmental challenges into deployable, real-world solutions. With a foundation in engineering science, data analytics, and AI systems design, he leads the technical development of AI-assisted environmental models, automation pipelines, and research-driven prototypes. His work focuses on scalable, ethical AI for environmental remediation and sustainability, bridging data, software, and physical systems to create technology that serves both people and planet.

name: John Villa
bio: John Villa serves as the Operations and Research Assistant at Nexus Verium, providing critical support to the Chief Research Coordinator in the execution of interdisciplinary initiatives. He specializes in streamlining administrative workflows, maintaining research documentation, and supporting the transition from conceptual frameworks to scalable prototypes. John’s focus is on enhancing operational agility and ensuring the seamless integration of research data across the organization’s diverse project portfolio.

name: Fasih Ur Rehman Abbasi
bio: Fasih Ur Rehman Abbasi is the Chief Research Coordinator and Operations Lead at Nexus Verium, where he oversees the design, coordination, and execution of interdisciplinary research and applied innovation initiatives. With a strong foundation in STEM and systems thinking, he bridges environmental science, engineering, and AI-assisted technologies to translate complex ideas into structured research frameworks, scalable prototypes, and real-world implementations. His work focuses on ensuring methodological rigor, operational efficiency, and responsible deployment across Nexus Verium's projects.

name: Eidan Jimenez
bio: Serving as a pivotal member of the team, this individual is responsible for the comprehensive development and strategic management of the project's entire web infrastructure. They specialize in crafting robust frontend architectures that prioritize user experience, while building highly scalable backend systems designed for peak performance. Furthermore, they oversee efficient database administration and ensure data integrity, providing a stable foundation that allows the platform to evolve alongside shifting business objectives.
